id.description: The unique identifier for the message

chatId.description: The ID of the chat this message belongs to

senderId.description: The eName of the user who sent the message. Entity references are eNames: an @-prefixed W3ID such as @48468c9a-dc1b-5663-92fb-5e46e3d2a7f0. eNames are used rather than User profile MetaEnvelope ids because they are stable, self-describing, and resolvable without a profile envelope, which a newly provisioned eVault may not have yet.

content.description: The text content of the message

mediaUrl.description: URL to media attachment if message type is image or file

readBy.description: Array of eNames of users who have read the message.

updatedAt.description: When the message was last updated
